sentences.text: Please see "Risk Factors" below for a discussion of material risks and uncertainties that could impact Citigroup's businesses, results of operations and financial condition.

While it is likely that there will be changes in the way major financial institutions are regulated in both the U.S. and other markets in which we operate, it remains difficult to predict the exact impact these changes will have on our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows for a particular future period.
